description: Defines the InputConnectionsProvider interface for accessing input device connections via file descriptors in the Cuttlefish virtualization environment.

classes.name: InputConnectionsProvider
classes.description: Abstract class providing access to input device connection file descriptors for virtualization purposes.

methods.name: RotaryDeviceConnection
methods.description: Returns the connection for the rotary device.

methods.name: MouseConnection
methods.description: Returns the connection for the mouse device.

methods.name: KeyboardConnection
methods.description: Returns the connection for the keyboard device.

methods.name: SwitchesConnection
methods.description: Returns the connection for switch inputs.

methods.name: TouchscreenConnections
methods.description: Returns the connections for touchscreen input devices as a vector of file descriptors.

methods.name: TouchpadConnections
methods.description: Returns the connections for touchpad input devices as a vector of file descriptors.
